original_value: Ship detection in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images is becoming a research hotspot. In recent years, as the rise of artificial intelligence, deep learning has almost dominated SAR ship detection community for its higher accuracy, faster speed, less human intervention, etc. However, today, there is still a lack of a reliable deep learning SAR ship detection dataset that can meet the practical migration application of ship detection in large-scene space-borne SAR images. Thus, to solve this problem, this paper releases a Large-Scale SAR Ship Detection Dataset-v1.0 (LS-SSDD-v1.0) from Sentinel-1, for small ship detection under large-scale backgrounds. LS-SSDD-v1.0 contains 15 large-scale SAR images whose ground truths are correctly labeled by SAR experts by drawing support from the Automatic Identification System (AIS) and Google Earth. To facilitate network training, the large-scale images are directly cut into 9000 sub-images without bells and whistles, providing convenience for subsequent detection result presentation in large-scale SAR images. Notably, LS-SSDD-v1.0 has five advantages: (1) large-scale backgrounds, (2) small ship detection, (3) abundant pure backgrounds, (4) fully automatic detection flow, and (5) numerous and standardized research baselines. Last but not least, combined with the advantage of abundant pure backgrounds, we also propose a Pure Background Hybrid Training mechanism (PBHT-mechanism) to suppress false alarms of land in large-scale SAR images. Experimental results of ablation study can verify the effectiveness of the PBHT-mechanism. LS-SSDD-v1.0 can inspire related scholars to make extensive research into SAR ship detection methods with engineering application value, which is conducive to the progress of SAR intelligent interpretation technology.

result.paraphrase: Ship detection in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery has emerged as a research hotspot. With the recent rise of artificial intelligence, deep learning has largely come to dominate the SAR ship detection community because of its higher accuracy, faster speed, and reduced human intervention. However, there is still no reliable deep learning SAR ship detection dataset that satisfies practical transfer applications for ship detection in large-scene space-borne SAR images. To address this issue, this paper releases the Large-Scale SAR Ship Detection Dataset-v1.0 (LS-SSDD-v1.0) derived from Sentinel-1, designed for small ship detection in large-scale backgrounds. LS-SSDD-v1.0 includes 15 large-scale SAR images, and their ground truths are accurately labeled by SAR experts with support from the Automatic Identification System (AIS) and Google Earth. For easier network training, the large-scale images are directly split into 9000 sub-images without additional processing, making later detection-result presentation in large-scale SAR images more convenient. Notably, LS-SSDD-v1.0 offers five advantages: (1) large-scale backgrounds, (2) small ship detection, (3) abundant pure backgrounds, (4) fully automatic detection flow, and (5) numerous and standardized research baselines. Finally, leveraging the abundance of pure backgrounds, we also propose a Pure Background Hybrid Training mechanism (PBHT-mechanism) to reduce land false alarms in large-scale SAR images. Ablation-study results verify the effectiveness of the PBHT-mechanism. LS-SSDD-v1.0 may encourage related researchers to conduct extensive studies on SAR ship detection methods with engineering application value, thereby contributing to the advancement of SAR intelligent interpretation technology.
